Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc-Lko:59694
Court No. - 14

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 10224 of 2023
Applicant :- Satyendra Alias Lendar

Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
Counsel for Applicant :- Pratap Krishan,Ravi Prakash Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mohd. Faiz Alam Khan,J.
1.
Counter affidavit, filed on behalf of the State, is taken on record.

2. Heard Mr. Pratap Krishan, learned counsel for the accused-applicant, as well as learned A.G.A.
for the State and perused the record.
3.

This bail application has been moved by the accused/applicant- Satyendra alias Lendar for grant of bail, in Case Crime No.032 of 2023, under Sections 323, 354 and 376 IPC lodged at Police Station Bakshi-Ka-Talab, District Lucknow, during trial.
4. Learned counsel for the accused-applicant submits that it is a case of false implication.

The FIR of the instant case has been lodged by mother of the victim on 04.02.2023 against the applicant pertaining to the incident, which allegedly occurred on 10.01.2023 at about 5 p.m. wherein it is alleged that the applicant has molested and outraged modesty of the victim.

sentences.text: Highlighting the above facts, it is vehemently submitted that the FIR of this case appears to have been lodged on information provided by the victim and, there is no whisper of commission of rape therein.

It is also submitted that even in the statement of the informant/complainant recorded under Section 161 CrPC, there is no allegation pertaining to commission of sexual assault by the applicant and, even in the statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 CrPC, she has only alleged molestation and, has not stated anything about commission of rape with her.

It is further submitted that after 2-3 days of recording of statement of the victim under Section 161 CrPC, her statement was recorded under Section 164 CrPC wherein she has made material improvements and alleged commission of rape by the applicant, however, the subsequent development by alleging rape by the applicant is not found corroboration of the medical evidence as no abnormality or injury has been found on the person of the victim.
Moreover, the FIR has been lodged after more 20 days of the alleged incident and, no explanation has been given of such delay.
6. It is further submitted that the applicant has been languishing in jail in this case since 07.02.2023 and, he is not having any previous criminal history.
Charge sheet in this case has already been filed and there is no apprehension that after being released on bail he may flee from the course of law or may otherwise misuse the liberty.
7. Learned A.G.A., however, opposes the prayer of bail of the applicant on the ground that the applicant has committed an heinous offence and, therefore, he is not entitled to be released on bail.
8. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and having perused the record, it appears to be an admitted case that the age of the prosecutrix/victim is 34 years.
The FIR has been lodged by mother of the prosecutrix/victim on information provided by her.

The prosecutrix, in her statement recorded under Section 161 CrPC, has not alleged any allegation of rape, however, in her statement recorded under Section 164 CrPC, she for the very first time has alleged commission of rape by the applicant.
The medical examination report of the prosecutrix is not containing any injury or abnormality.
The pathological report of the prosecutrix is also clean.
There is a delay of more than 20 days in lodging of the FIR.
The applicant is in jail in this case since 07.02.2023 without any previous criminal antecedents.
Charge sheet in this case has also been filed and the presence of the applicant may be secured before the trial court by placing adequate conditions.

9. Keeping in view the nature of the offence, evidence, complicity of the accused, severity of punishment, submissions of the learned counsel for the parties and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I am of the considered view that applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is thus allowed.

10. Let the accused/applicant-Satyendra alias Lendar involved in above-mentioned case, be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: (ii) The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
11. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.
12. Identity, status and residence proof of the applicant and sureties be verified by the Court concerned before the bonds are accepted.

13. Observations made herein-above by this court are only for the purpose of disposal of this bail application and shall not be construed as an expression on the merits of the case.
.
[Mohd. Faiz Alam Khan,J.]
